Library: notification_manager

Purpose: Dispatch alerts/notifications to external channels (Telegram, Feishu, etc.).

Key Modules:
- notification_manager.py: Unified API for sending notifications.
- telegram_notifier.py: Telegram channel implementation.
- feishu_notifier.py: Feishu channel implementation.
- template_manager.py: Message templating.

CLI (cli.py):
- Entrypoint: `python -m notifications.src.lib.notification_manager.cli`
- Flags: `--help`, `--version`, `--format json|text`
- Commands: `send`, `template-test`

Data Contracts:
- Message payloads as JSON (title, body, severity, context)

Notes:
- Do not log secrets (API tokens); follow security guidance in constitution.
